label: rare end-of-input firing in long sequences (no specific trigger found)
explanation: Very sparse feature (488 dev steps, ~0.008% of steps). It fires only at the last one or two original tokens or on <DEL>, mostly in L=8-9 sequences (t=7-9), and never in the copy phase or at t<3. Within that window it fires on about 1 in 1000 steps (precision ~0.001 at recall ~0.67). It is enriched for first token g/h/e/3/x/j, current input w/e/d, prev input d/n, and next output g, but conjunctions of these reach F1 of only ~0.06. Magnitude is small (mean 0.13, max 0.21); top-quartile activations are somewhat more often inside the end-of-input window (coverage 0.81 vs 0.55 for the lowest quartile). No coherent predicate isolates the actual firing set.
